claims: Transfuse packed red blood cells for severe anemia (hemoglobin 6.8 g/dL, consent documented).
Assess and manage hypotension (MAP 65 mmHg, SBP 81 mmHg) with fluid resuscitation and vasopressor titration.
Continue mechanical ventilation with lung-protective settings, targeting SpO2 92-96% and avoiding hyperoxia.
Monitor arterial blood gases and lactate to assess oxygenation and perfusion.
Monitor hemoglobin and hematocrit to assess response to transfusion.
Check and replete electrolytes, including potassium and magnesium, as needed.
Continue insulin infusion with hourly glucose monitoring to maintain glucose 70-100 mg/dL.
Monitor platelet count and coagulation parameters given thrombocytopenia and coagulopathy.
Perform chest imaging to evaluate pulmonary status and line positions.
Maintain temporary pacemaker settings and monitor rhythm.
